newborn.title: Newborn
newborn.description: You created an account. That's it. That's your accomplishment for today.

barely_functional.title: Growing Up
barely_functional.description: You completed a few tasks! Granted, it was probably just 'open laptop', but progress is progress.

task_rookie.title: The New Guy
task_rookie.description: 70% of your completed tasks are just checking off things you already did.

procrastination_survivor.title: New Cadet
procrastination_survivor.description: You didn't beat procrastination, you just learned to run faster than it.

productivity_amateur.title: Private
productivity_amateur.description: You now have 47 open browser tabs and 3 color-coded highlighters you don't use.

deadline_runner.title: Veteran
deadline_runner.description: You only do your best work when there are 12 minutes left before midnight.

task_grinder.title: Lieutenant-designate
task_grinder.description: Your bloodstream is currently 40% espresso and 60% anxiety.

productivity_addict.title: Ambitious Lieutenant
productivity_addict.description: You complete daily tasks not for self-improvement, but out of pure fear of losing your streak.

calendar_warrior.title: Promoted to Major
calendar_warrior.description: Your calendar is color-coded so aggressively it looks like a game of Tetris.

deadline_destroyer.title: Future General
deadline_destroyer.description: Deadlines don't scare you anymore. You scare them.

corporate_machine.title: Sycophantic General
corporate_machine.description: Autopilot activated. You replied to anything with "Yes sir, yes Ma'am"

human_todo_list.title: Five-Star Politician
human_todo_list.description: You schedule bathroom breaks and lunch slots down to the exact second.

productivity_overlord.title: Minister of Time
productivity_overlord.description: You optimized your morning routine so hard you saved 4 minutes to stare blankly at a wall.

task_deity.title: Assistant of the Emperor
task_deity.description: You no longer do work. Work submits itself to you out of respect.

productivity_final_boss.title: The Emperor
productivity_final_boss.description: You have automated your entire job, life, and personal relationships.

the_system_fears_you.title: Master of Time
the_system_fears_you.description: You never missed any task, we're starting to believe you can turn back time.

why_are_you_still_here.title: Cosmic Overlord
why_are_you_still_here.description: Water, wind, earth and fire. That's you my lord!
